title: EDA Trigger Node
description: Workflow entry point triggered by Event-Driven Ansible webhook events

webhook_path.description: Unique URL slug identifying this EDA webhook endpoint (e.g., 'jira-updates'). Becomes part of the final URL: /api/v1/webhooks/eda/{webhook_path}

input_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema (Draft-07) for validating incoming EDA webhook payloads. If set, requests with non-conforming payloads are rejected with 422 Unprocessable Content.

authorized_service_account_ids.description: UUIDs of service accounts authorized to invoke this EDA trigger endpoint

resultSchema.description: Trigger result is the EDA webhook request body passed through directly

oneOf.title: Failed Result
oneOf.description: Trigger failure output for reporting purposes
